The minimum operator requires both prior research commitment and current capex acceleration, preventing the signal from being ordered primarily by the capital-investment anomaly.

---CRITIQUE Persistent Tangible Budget Shift---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: This is a near-cosmetic variant of the archived "Capex Reallocation from R&D" (3-year TREND instead of 1-year DELTA of the identical ratio), and the COALESCE(xrd,0) choice creates a large mass of exactly-zero trends for stable non-R&D firms that will dominate the middle of the rank distribution rather than cleanly separating reallocators.

---CRITIQUE Positive R&D Workforce Scaling---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: The truncation at positive employment growth is a substantive (not cosmetic) diagnosis of the archived signal's slope/alpha conflict, but zeroing out all shrinking firms plus all non-R&D reporters piles a large fraction of the cross-section at a single value, so the resulting spread will be close to long-only and the interpretation of any FMB slope will be muddied.

---CRITIQUE Positive Dual-Capital Payoff---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: Truncating to positive sales growth is a defensible fix for the non-monotonicity implied by the archived version's negative slope and positive alpha, but the expression is mechanically sales growth times the inverse of investment intensity, so much of its power will simply reproduce the well-documented investment/asset-growth anomaly rather than a genuine dual-capital productivity effect.

---CRITIQUE Debt-Funded Knowledge Exposure---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 4
RATIONALE: The financing-times-intangibility interaction is a genuinely cross-theme construction with a coherent collateral/distress mechanism, and the required-high-on-both bottleneck works against the known positive R&D-intensity effect rather than piggybacking on it, though the debt-issuance anomaly may still drive most of the variation and should be checked for dominance.

---CRITIQUE Goodwill-Heavy Acquisition Allocation---
VERDICT: flag
SCORE: 2
RATIONALE: This is essentially the archived "Goodwill-Laden External Investment" with capx swapped for xrd in the denominator and gdwl scaled by at instead of intan — a mechanical respecification of an already-tested and already-failing signal that also overlaps heavily with the published goodwill/acquirer underperformance literature.

---CRITIQUE Research-to-Capacity Conversion---
VERDICT: accept
SCORE: 3
RATIONALE: Sequencing lagged R&D intensity ahead of capex acceleration is a reasonably distinct commercialization hypothesis rather than a repeat of the archived contemporaneous ppent/R&D-growth version, but the long leg is by construction high-and-accelerating investment, so the expected positive sign is fighting the robust investment anomaly and the claim that the MIN operator neutralizes it is asserted rather than argued.
